status: in development; portfolio describes existing implemented capabilities, no quality or speed benchmarks
architecture: Go embedded local UI/server and single GPU job queue
FFprobe/FFmpeg extraction of selected original audio
Python CUDA worker with one model resident at a time
recognition: fast mode one selected model; precision mode two or more selected models executed sequentially
reference priority Qwen > v3 > v2 > turbo
alignment: spoken-text alignment against original audio, word timestamps in integer absolute milliseconds
display text and spoken alignment text are separate
VAD widens display boundary at most 0.3 seconds, does not overwrite raw word timing or cross neighbours
waveform amplitude alone is not speech identification
ai_review: Codex CLI, Claude Code, or cross-review
AI selects readable split boundaries with word times, pauses, 100ms waveform levels 0..9
split timestamps come from aligned word times, not unrestricted LLM-generated milliseconds
cross-review disagreements can be debated up to twice; agreement split is applied, unresolved split becomes proposal
text correction proposals carry reason/evidence and require user acceptance; provider text schema disallows time fields
optional selected video frames and text/context sent to correction CLI; audio remains local
editor: subtitle text/time editing, split/merge/add/delete, undo/redo, find/replace
manual display times protected on re-alignment
SRT import UTF-8 BOM/CP949, time-ordered export with optional UTF-8 BOM
applications: reviewing terminology and readable boundaries using video context
privacy_scope: Read source/documents only; do not execute original app, download models, inspect private recordings/AI logs/settings, or copy private media. Diagram/data example is allowed but is not an original app screenshot.
